description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of data sources within a combined training set, specifically for the dataset “XSUMHUL”. The chart contains ten slices representing different data sources. The largest slice, labeled “NQ”, is blue and accounts for 31.3% of the total. “SNLI” is represented by a light blue slice at 15.4%, followed by “FEVER” in a darker blue at 16.1%. “MULTIFC” is orange and represents 11.3%, while “VITAMIN” is a reddish-orange slice at 13.0%. Smaller slices include “FACTCC” at 2.6%, “ANLI” at 4.6%, “SCIFACT” at 1.8%, “MULTINLI” at 0.5%, “PUBHEALTH” at 0.5%, and “SCITAIL” at 1.2%. The smallest slice, labeled “ENTFA”, is yellow and represents 0.1%. Percentage labels are displayed inside each slice, and a legend is present to identify each data source. The slices appear to be ordered clockwise by descending size, with “NQ” starting at the top and the smallest slices grouped together on the right side of the chart.
